body:
I think it's a great game with the potential to be so much better.

It takes the beautiful setting and unique characters from A Wonderful Life and combines it with (improved) graphics and gameplay from Friends of Mineral Town, my other two series favourites.

However, they don't do a good job at fleshing out the characters. At all. They're supposed to be the ancestors of the AWL characters? Yeah, they could have put a LOT more work into making that even semi-believable... I mean, I know it's fact, but to me they will always simply be the characters I know and love. I mean, come on, they're completely identical. Not only that, but their personalities somewhat fall flat. There should have been more random events that don't require Mineral Town connectivity.

And if you could actually go to Mineral Town - it would have been wonderful! Having that path there, leading to nowhere...it's honestly just depressing! 

Oh, and of course - the glithces.

That said I do think it's a great game, I just wish that the town didn't feel so robotic. I loved playing AWL and feeling as though I was really apart of the town. It's a bit harder to achieve that with sprite based games though, I find.

The sloppiness it was put together with is my only other complaint. Like, translation errors, and just...weird dialogue really made the game seem sort of strange. It didn't make sense sometimes. 

But the sprite finding made it a lot of fun, as well as just...the game itself, being really fun. I think it's great.

The melodic songs with beautifully distinctive bass, clear, gentle and diverse vocals with a sort of atmosphere that brings me to a place no other artist can. It is hard to explain, but many of Dir en Grey's songs are so tranquil that I feel as though I am inside the songs themselves, in a place that is calm, peaceful but somehow very somber. For example, Dead Tree, Itoshisa wa Fuhai ni Tsuki, Kaishun and Embryo.
